svg.title: B26 HELIOS POWERLOOP — Solar Electrolysis Dispatch engineering architecture
svg.desc: The diagram establishes a constrained simulation boundary with independent energy checks and explicit stack geometry. Dispatch results compare forecast-aware policies and resource tradeoffs without implying a connected controller or verified hardware envelope.
